
DESCRIPTION
Generate or refresh optional mise tool and task configuration

USAGE
  one init mise [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one init mise --dry-run -o json
  one init mise
  one run dev -p web

COMMON OPTIONS
  --dry-run                Print proposed file contents without writing files or executing mise
  --go-version <value>     Exact workspace Go version (default: existing root pin or highest module requirement)
  --node-version <value>   Exact Node version (default: previous generated version or 24.15.0)
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
